notes: Source files are stored exactly as supplied (never edited in place). Derived plates/layers are produced by scripts and noted per asset. status: supplied -> inspected -> approved.

assets.provenance: user-supplied (generated by the user with ChatGPT image generation)

inspection.resolution: Below 1920x1080: needs 1.15x upscale to fill frame; ~1.25x with a gentle push-in. Acceptable for a painted plate with slight depth-of-field; 2560x1440+ preferred if regenerated.
inspection.lighting: Warm late-sun key from the window at frame left; sunlit pool on the floor centre-left. Compatible with Milo's soft warm key.
inspection.perspective: Low, near-floor eye level with a large open floor area (approx. x 450-1150, y 600-900): suits a puppy-height camera.
inspection.style: Painterly 3D storybook render; consistent with Milo's sheet.

assets.provenance: user-supplied (generated by the user with ChatGPT image generation)

inspection.transparency: Clean cut-out, no white fringe. Interior alpha is ~253 (lossy WebP) and will be clamped to fully opaque on import.
inspection.orientation: Side view, toe pointing right, heel/collar on the left. Stage 2 Milo art must approach and bite the heel from the left.
inspection.style: More photoreal (suede + shearling product render) than Milo/background; will get a warm grade and a soft contact shadow so it sits in the scene.
inspection.states: Single resting state. Lifted/sagging states optional (see scenes/sc01-workshop-slipper/README.md).
